newsitem.title: UK: Iran features again in sugar freight inquiry.
newsitem.headline: Iran features again in sugar freight inquiry.

text.p: Business was subdued on the sugar freight market on Wednesday although Iranian offtake continued to be evident as the country featured as an end-destination for bagged sugar, shipbrokers said.
E D & F Man quoted for 28,000 tonnes in bags from Santander to Iran for 20/30 March and was said to be on subjects with its recent order for a 14,000-tonne bagged cargo from Acajutla to Colombo.
Man was also said to have fixed 12,000 tonnes of bagged sugar from Thailand to Colombo or Pakistan for mid-March. Details of the rate have yet to emerge.
Shipbrokers said a subsidiary of Chinese operator Top Glory quoted for 10/11,500 tonnes of bagged sugar from south China to Pakistan or Red Sea for 20 March onwards.
